strategy.summary: Complete the drop bank to light R-A-C-E shots, spell RACE, lock two balls through the left ramp, then cycle Jackpot, Bonus Jackpot, and Super Jackpot scoring.

quickInfo.name: Race Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Each drop-bank completion lights a R-A-C-E shot; spelling RACE lights two locks and the left-ramp start.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot cycle
quickInfo.summary: A lit Jackpot enables the left-ramp Bonus Jackpot, which expands the next Jackpot set and lights the drops for Super.

quickInfo.name: Racetrack
quickInfo.summary: The Bonus Jackpot sends a ball around the track; SPIN ejects it and freezes a higher Jackpot value.

quickInfo.name: Garage
quickInfo.summary: Test-car hits expose the Garage scoop; spinners rotate its available mode or Multiball award.

steps.text: Use ball save to test the drop bank, left-ramp Hauler target, right ramp, captive SPIN target, and Garage eject.
Complete the three-bank drops to light a R-A-C-E shot, then collect the lit major shot.
Repeat until RACE is complete and the left ramp lights lock.
Shoot the left ramp to lock two balls, then shoot it again to start Race Multiball.
Collect the lit Jackpot, then shoot the left ramp for the Bonus Jackpot.
Use SPIN to cash out a racetrack ball at a better value, complete the relit drops for Super, and repeat the expanded Jackpot cycle.
modeNotes: Race Multiball cycle: Jackpot, left-ramp Bonus Jackpot, expanded Jackpot set, and drop-bank Super Jackpot qualification.

fallback.title: Garage Multiball
fallback.when: Use this when the RACE drops reject but the Test Car and scoop are safe.

steps.text: Hit the Test Car until the Garage scoop is exposed.
Use the spinners to move the flashing Garage award to a useful Multiball.
Start the selected Garage award and take its lit Jackpot route.

alternatives.title: Orbit and Road Course scoring
alternatives.when: Use this when the short-track orbits are repeatable and Multiball remains distant.

steps.text: Repeat either orbit while its return remains controlled to add short-track laps.
Start Speed Shots, Hard Racin', or Road Course when lit.
Return to RACE qualification after the timed value ends.
Start Speed Shots from the left-orbit buildup, Hard Racin' from the right-orbit buildup, and Road Course after enough short-track laps.
Reach first place with the Hauler car target or lit SPIN target to start Victory Lap.
Each of those four starts awards a C-H-A-M-P-#1 letter; Mode Bonus can award another letter.
After C-H-A-M-P-#1 is complete, shoot the far-left Scanner eject to start four-ball CHAMP #1 Multiball.

techniques.name: Racetrack value freeze
techniques.instruction: After the Bonus Jackpot sends a ball around the track, hit SPIN when the displayed value justifies ending its laps.

cautions.issue: A Hauler hit can lock, pass through Pit Road, or return differently depending on lamp and diverter state.
cautions.response: Read the lock and diverter lamps before every left-ramp shot.

cautions.issue: The racetrack, magnets, and Pit Road locks can hold or release balls unexpectedly when dirty or misadjusted.
cautions.response: Test the mechanism before relying on precise timing or ball-count assumptions.

strategy.simpleOverview: In NASCAR, each drop-bank completion lights the next R-A-C-E shot. Spell RACE, lock twice, and start Multiball at the left ramp. During Multiball, cycle Jackpot, left-ramp Bonus Jackpot, and the relit drops for Super; use Garage awards between starts.
strategy.overview: NASCAR's drop bank and R-A-C-E shots qualify Multiball. Prioritize RACE, then repeat its Jackpot, Bonus Jackpot, SPIN, and Super cycle. Use Garage awards, short-track laps, and race-position progress between Multiball starts.
